weak.$description:
Data colour brand, weak — the brand's own hue, offered alongside the eleven that carry no meaning of their own so a series that *is* the brand can be drawn as such. Varies by brand: it follows color.primary, so the same chart is a different colour in each brand. Moves with the theme: a light step in light, a dark one in dark, so it always stays close to the surface behind it. Decorative — it is not held to a contrast ratio against anything.

Used in:
Quiet fills — the area or bar of the one series that represents the brand itself, the ground of a brand-owned tag. Pair with color-data.brand.strong, which draws the edge of the same shape. A label on it is color-content.static.primary.

Do not:
Do not use it for any series that is not the brand — those are the eleven hues, starting at color-data.blue.weak. Two brand-coloured series in one chart tell the reader nothing apart.

strong.$description:
Data colour brand, strong — the brand's own hue, offered alongside the eleven that carry no meaning of their own so a series that *is* the brand can be drawn as such. Varies by brand: it follows color.primary, so the same chart is a different colour in each brand. One step lighter in dark than in light, so it clears 3:1 in both themes. Below AA by design: color-content.static.fixed-white on it holds 4.6:1 in light and 3.7:1 in dark, and as text it is 4.6:1 on color-surface.static.primary, 4.1:1 on .secondary and 3.7:1 on .tertiary in light and 3.5:1 and 4.2:1 on .primary and .secondary in dark, short of the 4.5:1 of SC 1.4.3. As a stroke it meets the 3:1 of SC 1.4.11 in both themes.

Used in:
The half of the pair that carries structure: strokes and borders — the line of the brand's own series, the outline of a brand-owned tag — the text of an outline tag, and the ground of a solid tag with color-content.static.fixed-white on top. Its text and its strokes are accepted only when the same data is also shown in a readable form — a legend, a value in the row. Pair with color-data.brand.weak as the quiet fill it outlines.

Do not:
Do not stand in for color-surface.static.brand.strong — a chart series is not a brand surface, and the two are free to drift apart. A label that must be read on its own takes color-content.static.primary on color-data.brand.weak, which holds AA in both themes.
